notes.title: 《新叶旅者与少年的回忆》2nd 更新补丁上线！
notes.notes:
本次新增伽雷的约会事件！白老板的个人结局追加！
优化了角色升级时的特效显示！
追加了角色在野外探索时饿肚子的提示效果！
为防止卡关，调整了部分关卡的触发时间点！

notes.title: The 1st bug fix and updated patch for 'Memories of New Leaf Travelers and Youth'
notes.notes:
This update includes 2 new mainline events!

And fix some bugs! (Including missing images, bug in automatic archiving has been fixed)

PS: This update has caused the archive path to be changed!

Players who have played games before, please open the game folder and manually replace and save to a new Save folder!



We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to everyone<
